findings.evidence: Lines 113–116 use `change IsReduced (Spec (CommRingCat.of H))`; `TauCeti/AlgebraicGeometry/AffineGroupScheme/HopfSpec.lean` provides the explicit lemma `hopfSpec_obj_X_left`.

summary: The proofs contain undocumented definitional-equality manipulation and one unfolding-heavy bridge that is coupled to implementation details.
